Tech stocks are again trying for a rebound in Thursday trading.
Among technology stocks moving on news:

- Infosys ( INFY ) was retreating in Thursday's early market, sinking over 4%, after the technology outsourcing company said it was partnering with Siemens PLM Software to develop applications and services for the Siemens unit's MindSphere operating system. Under terms of the companies' collaboration agreement, Infosys will provide end-to-end implementation services and post-implementation support for the open cloud-based internet-of-things operating system connecting machinery and other equipment to the digital world.
